## New continuation: exact-clock amplification and directed residue covers

**Collatz remains OPEN.** Three GPT-6.2 Astra lanes developed the finite-row attack, directed affine covers and Lean verification, followed by independent cross-reviews and coordinator reconstruction.

**Published head:** `2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859`  
**Science commit:** `1e19e9d1a6ca78649c516efc647259b069697ecb`  
**Science tree:** `c0c9ab919a1ec2b441caf1ebfaf5943713c6d55d`

[Science overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/FINITE_CLOSURE.md) · [Coordinator review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Exact source intake](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/SOURCE_INTAKE.json)

### 1. A finite exact-row dichotomy covering escape and nontrivial cycles

On the row with exactly b odd steps and 2b shortcut steps, count actual unit sources at one supplied ordinary unit endpoint q>1 with relative affine carry at least epsilon. Retain a path if q>b/64 or a recorded shortcut state repeats. Let R_b(epsilon) be the maximum over eligible endpoints.

- If Collatz is true, R_b(epsilon) is eventually zero for every fixed positive rational epsilon below one.
- If any counterexample exists, some fixed epsilon has R_b(epsilon) >= 2^ceil(b/32) at EVERY sufficiently large b, at one actual terminal per row. The lower count survives separately in each prescribed unit source class modulo 3^K with 2*3^(K+1)+1 <= b/40.
- A cofinal upper estimate below that threshold for every epsilon would therefore settle Collatz. **That upper estimate is not proved.**

The written proof uses an elementary binary inverse tree, a two-gap exact-clock/source-residue correction, and the retained actual suffix. It does not assume the earlier analytic inverse floor F or pair-renewal law R. The finite simple-path reciprocal bound is rederived and independently reviewed. The statistic can be computed by scanning sources below ((1-epsilon)/epsilon)*2^b, with no convergence oracle.

A version using a finite forward test h(b) -> infinity has lower count 2^floor(b/16). At a fixed unit q>1, a single exact-row witness with relative carry at least 1-2^(-100) characterizes periodicity; repeated cycle suffixes then supply exponential counts on every sufficiently large row at the same q. These remain reductions, not cycle exclusions.

[Full finite-row proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/escape-analysis/README.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/ESCAPE_CROSS_REVIEW.md) · [Executed controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/escape-analysis/CONTROLS.json)

### 2. Either direction on either odd unit residue suffices

Fix r=1 OR r=5 modulo six. Every positive odd n has a directed path to 3n using ordinary shortcut edges in either direction and forward triplings only at u=r mod6. The complete tables cover 948 and 1,263 disjoint infinite progressions, with 84,642 affine letters. Their universal statements are now kernel-checked in Lean.

Combined with PR195's pinned directed descent consumer, EACH of the four individual laws is equivalent to global convergence: choose one residue, then choose either C(u) => C(3u) or C(3u) => C(u). The paths preserve the ordering of a binary-label crossing, injectivity of each query map and bounded height distortion. They do not merge the original trajectories through their extra tripling moves.

The quantitative transfer, combined with PR146's explicitly pinned written cut estimates and the published Krasikov-Lagarias predecessor theorem, forces the .84 count exponent in each selected residue and direction under a counterexample. Head-series and moving-window refinements retain their separate density, pair and sampling inputs. None supplies the opposing upper estimate.

[Proof and complete tables](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/global-bridge/README.md) · [Independent table review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/GLOBAL_CROSS_REVIEW.md)

### 3. Actual Lean and finite verification

- 13 successful compiler executions; 46 distinct theorem declarations (22 earlier, 24 new) and 24 additional axiom-audited declarations.
- General ordinary gap-word legality from full divisibility, exact shortcut-clock attachment, source-class equivalence and uniqueness, finite carry cutoff, and the two-gap router.
- A proved semantic checker plus both full affine-cover decisions. The closed decisions use no axioms. Their universal tripling applications use only propext and Quot.sound; the union over the whole audit is limited to the three standard Lean axioms.
- Original candidate bytes are preserved. The four original proof bodies were replayed with narrow imports; final portable copies have no diagnostics. Benign warnings in two original import-only executions are recorded rather than suppressed from the receipt.
- New exact controls passed in normal and optimized Python with identical outputs and zero AST assert nodes. Coverage includes 6,760 two-gap cases, 480 direct-vs-inverse row comparisons and 40,336 literal padded sources. All four earlier BigInt programs were also replayed against their published result payloads.

[Lean scope and replay](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/lean/README.md) · [Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/lean/RECEIPT.json) · [Fresh finite replay](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/NEW_CONTROLS_REPLAY.json) · [Source manifest](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859/reports/astra-continuation-audit-20261124/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json)

Lean 4.34.1 (`5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`), mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`. Infinite counting arguments, the full finite-row dichotomy and analytic transfers remain written mathematics. A successful finite kernel check is not a proof of the missing universal estimate.

## Continuation — polynomial-width exact-clock source bands

**Published continuation:** `02fb390a76fb2ffb00fee612649ca23a82d99d31`. [Proof packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/02fb390a76fb2ffb00fee612649ca23a82d99d31/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/thin-band/README.md) · [Lean candidate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/02fb390a76fb2ffb00fee612649ca23a82d99d31/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/thin-band/ThinBand.lean) · [Executed controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/02fb390a76fb2ffb00fee612649ca23a82d99d31/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/thin-band/CONTROLS.json).

The unconditional long-padding construction localizes the exact (b,2b) row amplification to many disjoint bands of width at most 2^(8k), where k is between floor(log2 b)+1 and twice that value. Each eligible band has a common actual gate and endpoint and exponentially many in k literal witnesses in EVERY prescribed short mixed-adic source cylinder. A hypothetical counterexample forces at least K_b/2 such bands on every sufficiently large b, with one fixed gate parameter. A finite test restricted to these explicitly centered intervals is polynomial in b (not in log b), and cofinal absence for every fixed rational high-carry threshold is equivalent to Collatz. The upper absence estimate is still OPEN.

With the separate source-qualified F and synchronization inputs, each band of a suitable odd-count slice has a lower floor at linear mixed-prefix depth in k and a packing of >= c W/(k M) synchronized nonconvergent blocks of length M=exp(c sqrt(k)). This is much narrower real localization than macroscopic inverse block counts; it does not contradict PR207's normalized deep-suffix upper. No external F is needed for the elementary finite test. F's primary manuscript was inaccessible in this session, and its exact count statement is inherited conditionally from pinned PR201/203.

Executed exact BigInt: 48 sampled full paths at row b=2000, 192,000 shortcut steps, 16 mixed cells, three disjoint bands, 1,023 carry checks and 456 conditional normalization identities. An earlier larger attempt timed out and is not counted. **New Lean candidate uncompiled, no independent subagents or full-checkout validation in this session.** The prior audited checkpoint is preserved and its verification scope is unchanged. Collatz remains OPEN.

## Continuation — exact critical-record renewal dimension and rational departure obstruction

**Head:** `94ce06ccbd312ccd0ce4450b567cc514a2f0b54a`. [Written proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/94ce06ccbd312ccd0ce4450b567cc514a2f0b54a/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/record-renewal/README.md) · [Finite Lean candidate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/94ce06ccbd312ccd0ce4450b567cc514a2f0b54a/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/record-renewal/RecordRenewal.lean) · [Executed controls](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/94ce06ccbd312ccd0ce4450b567cc514a2f0b54a/research/killed-green-head-closure-20261124/record-renewal/CONTROLS.json).

Under bounded gaps J between strict coefficient records of one actual injective positive odd ray, neither its ternary record cluster set nor the cluster set of its bounded real renormalized errors can be finite, even allowing irrational candidate phases. A finite recurring transition graph forces negative rational fixed points; the dyadic denominator rule forces the entire actual future to follow one negative rational itinerary, contradicting fixed ordinary source divisibility. More generally one rational ternary cluster point forces rational points with unbounded dyadic denominators in the SAME cluster set, via the first actual departure from its negative cycle. Countable cluster sets contain a rational point by a compact minimal-system/Baire argument. Bounded record gaps are NOT proved for arbitrary escape; infinite cluster sets with unbounded dyadic denominators remain possible.

The universal bounded-gap critical trace has exact Hausdorff and box dimension d_J given by sum of N_m*3^(-d_J*m)=1 over m<=J, where N_m counts first strict ladder blocks. A bounded real inverse offset gives O_J(b) complete depth-b ternary overlap multiplicity. The full critical tree dimension is theta=0.94995552718833...; elementary concatenation proves equality. Caravenna's published centered finite-variance ladder-epoch tail (Remark 1, p.6 of the author preprint) yields theta-d_J~log(J)/(2 J log(3)). No auxiliary iid law is attributed to an actual orbit. The isolated-defect symbolic example shows why countability alone is not yet contradictory.

Executed BigInt: 154 ladder words, exact DP through depth 256, 3,426 concatenations/unique parses, 37,656 literal odd steps, 1,280 signed cycle steps, 4,551 wrong-gap checks, 13,653 dyadic-denominator steps, and 48 isolated-defect residue checks. Floating pressure roots are illustrations only. New Lean source is uncompiled; no independent subagents, full validator, or axiom audit. Earlier verified receipts remain scoped to their exact heads. **Collatz remains OPEN.**
